com.chaquo.python:target.name: CPython Android runtime
com.chaquo.python:target.note: The Maven MIT declaration covers the packaging wrapper. CPython and its native dependencies retain their own licenses. The Chaquopy 17.0.0 target recipe pins bzip2 1.0.8, libffi 3.4.4, OpenSSL 3.0.18, SQLite 3.50.4 and XZ 5.4.6. SQLite is in the public domain: https://sqlite.org/copyright.html .
